title: LDAP / BloodHound Enumeration (Active Directory)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for NORTH.SEVENKINGDOMS.LOCAL, no Windows VMs. Any authenticated user can read the directory over LDAP: a service account (svc_backup) carries its own password in its description attribute, and a nested group chain (IT Backup -> Vault Readers) grants it the only path to a protected share. From the foothold user hodor, enumerate the directory with ldapsearch / nxc / BloodHound, recover the leaked credential, follow the nested group path, and read the flag from the vault share only Vault Readers may open.
question: Enumerate Active Directory over LDAP from the hodor foothold, recover svc_backup's password from its description attribute, follow the nested group path to Vault Readers, and read the flag from the //dc/vault share.
